title: 第53章 天大的玩笑！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚全文完结版
content_zh: 公主殿下这纯属唐逸的诬陷。”唐画看到这公主不太聪明的样子，走了出来，展现出自己最迷人的笑容。他做了一个士子礼，笑容让人如沐春风：“殿下，我弟和弟妹已经说了，唐逸的小妹是自己摔倒……”萧澜自然是认识唐画的，看到唐画竟然说唐逸诬陷人，顿时就不满了。“你谁啊？你说摔的就是摔的？”“那我还说你们诬陷我的人，不，你们就是诬陷我的人。”萧澜抱着唐逸的手，唐逸抽了几次都没抽出去：“你们这么多人欺负他一个人，不要脸，我要去父皇那里告你们！”众人：“……”唐画：“？？”太子：“？？？”众人顿时都有些懵，什么鬼！什么叫我们这么多人欺负他一个？难道不是他一个人，欺负我们一群人吗？他在当着我们一群人的面行凶，搞得鸡飞狗跳的，你说我们欺负他？“咳咳……”唐逸干咳两声，道：“给我点面子，他们欺负不了我。”萧澜美眸一瞪，道：“是他们不给我面子，我干嘛要给你面子？”唐逸错愕地看着萧澜，不是，女人你这什么脑回路？“皇妹，你别太过分了。”太子脸色阴沉，一字一句：“他伤人，这里所有人有目共睹，但他说唐浩和林竹伤害他妹妹，那都是他的一面之词。”“你，不要被他给欺骗了。”“你会骗我吗？”萧澜美眸看向唐逸。“目前没有。”唐逸嘴角微抽，怎么有种狗血小情侣的既视感？你会负责吗？你会娶我吗？你不进去吧……“听到了？他说没骗，那就是没骗。”萧澜抬起头，美眸睨着全场：“今日，这个男人本宫保定了，谁不服，憋着！”话落，她拉着唐逸转身就走。孔诗岚站在萧澜身侧，见到这一幕只能无奈摇了摇头。说好的一切听我的呢？遇到这狗男人，你把承诺都忘得干干净净了。然而，太子卫守在前方，没有让路。萧澜转身，看向脸色铁青的太子，道：“太子哥哥，护卫，本宫也是有的。”“你真想和本宫开战吗？”话音刚落，唐逸便看到前方街道，迅速有上百穿着便装的人马向着天香楼围了过来。萧澜不喜欢人跟着，保护她的人，都在暗中。特别是经过昨晚的事后，皇帝增加了他的护卫人数，不是怕保护不了她，而是怕她又跑丢了。当场，所有人的目光都落在唐逸的身上。这家伙到底对公主做了什么？让堂堂刁蛮任性的高阳公主，对他这么死心塌地。唐敬更是吓得差点魂飞魄散，公主和太子捉对厮杀，那他唐家就该人头滚滚了。孔诗岚也吓到了，瞪了唐逸一眼：“想想办法劝住这小魔鬼，不然，事情要通天了。”唐逸也是满脸无语，这和他的计划出入太大了。本来他的计划，就是搅黄唐家的庆功宴，将来唐画的事情曝光，愤怒的皇帝便不会牵扯到他和唐音。再说自己又是给复合弓诸葛神弩，又是筹谋划策，皇帝总不能这么不给面子吧？只是他真没想到，一个唐家庆功宴，竟然将太子和公主都牵扯进来了。真打起来，那事情就失控了。“别，别，没必要，这是法治社会，咱们要讲法。”唐逸连忙拉住萧澜，道：“证据，我有，我有证据证明唐浩和林竹伤害了我妹妹。”“有个玉佩，是萧叔送给唐音的，被林竹抢走了。”唐逸看向唐敬，语气带着提醒：“唐侍郎，就是之前给我和唐音银子的那位萧叔。”轰隆！唐敬本来已经被吓得魂飞魄散了，现在听到唐逸的话，瞬间觉得天旋地转，一头栽倒在地。给唐逸和唐音银子的萧叔叔，就是当今皇帝萧策啊！老天。一个唐家宴会，竟然将皇族三个重量级的人给牵扯进来了。而林竹，竟然还抢走了陛下的玉佩。那是陛下的玉佩！众人看到唐敬吓得跪在了地上，也都震惊了。我去，还有大瓜？姓萧？谁？哪个姓萧的能将唐敬吓成这样？太子也是一阵诧异。“玉佩呢？小畜生，玉佩在哪？”这时，唐敬忽然暴起，直接冲到唐浩面前，抬手就是一个大嘴巴子！“玉佩呢？赶紧把玉佩给我。”唐敬声音都带着颤音。上一次颜霜玉私自用了陛下赏赐唐逸的银子，陛下和他聊了半炷香，差点将他聊到阎王殿。现在唐浩和林竹又抢走陛下赏赐给唐音的玉佩，能不能活着和陛下再聊半炷香还两说呢。要是以往，陛下肯定只是敲打敲打，可现在北狄和东虞大军压境，他不仅主张迁都，作为吏部侍郎还给儿子庆功……说不定陛下一不开心，他就是那只被杀了儆猴的鸡。唐浩当场就被打蒙了，他和林竹当日把唐音打得半死，的确是从唐音手中抢走了一块玉佩。只是他没想到一直不相信唐逸的父亲，竟然为了一个玉佩打他。林竹的脸色也是苍白下来，顾不得手上的疼痛，下意识想要将挂在腰间的那块极为好看的玉佩藏起来。但颜霜玉见到儿子被打，心疼坏了，没有意识到事情严重性的她，一把夺走林竹腰间的玉佩，快步拦在了唐敬的面前。“老爷，你打孩子干嘛，孩子有什么错。”“唐逸说一句话你就信，连辩解的机会都不给浩儿吗？”颜霜玉眼一眨，眼中立即蓄了泪。她又想用眼泪，忽悠瘸唐敬。“老爷，你别听小逸胡说，小浩和林竹没有抢夺唐音的玉佩。”“这玉佩，是臣妾给小浩和林竹置办的礼物，前两日，是他们结婚一周年的日子……”说着，她摊开了手掌。掌心中的玉佩便出现在了唐敬和太子的面前。然后唐敬石化当场，太子也如遭雷击。那是父皇的玉佩？！那是父皇的玉佩！父皇的玉佩成了这个女人置办的礼物？你在开天的玩笑吗？！“唐敬，你大胆！”随即，太子的暴怒声传开。好嘛，你家真会玩。孤在帮你们收拾唐逸，你们竟然敢在孤后面捅刀子。父皇的贴身玉佩出现在你妻子的手上，还成了她置办的礼物，特妈的这什么乱七八糟的？传出去人家会怎么说父皇？说父皇和你妻子有说不清道不明的关系吗？
content_en: Your Highness, this is purely a frame-up by Tang Yi."Tang Hua saw that the princess was not very smart, so he walked out and showed his most charming smile. He made a scholar ceremony, and his smile made people feel like spring breeze: "Your Highness, my brother and sister-in-law have already said that Tang Yi's little sister fell on her own..." Xiao Lan naturally knew Tang Hua, and when he saw that Tang Hua actually said that Tang Yi had framed someone, he immediately became dissatisfied. "Who are you?You said the one who fell was the one who fell?"Then I said you are the ones who framed me. No, you are the ones who framed me.""Xiao Lan held Tang Yi's hand, but Tang Yi smacked it several times without taking it out: "There are so many of you bullying him alone, it's shameless, I'm going to sue you to the emperor!"Everyone: "..." Tang Hua: "??"Prince:"???"Everyone was a little confused at once. What the hell! Why do so many of us bully him? Isn't he bullying a group of us? He is committing crimes in front of a group of us, making us crazy. You say we bully him? "Ahem..." Tang Yi coughed twice and said: "Give me some face, they can't bully me.Xiao Lan's beautiful eyes widened and she said, "They don't give me face, why should I give you face?""Tang Yi looked at Xiao Lan in astonishment, no, woman, what kind of thinking do you have? "Imperial sister, don't go too far.The prince's face was gloomy, and he said word by word: "He hurt people, and everyone here can see it. But when he said that Tang Hao and Lin Zhu hurt his sister, it was all his words.""You, don't be deceived by him.""Would you lie to me?""Xiao Lan looked at Tang Yi with beautiful eyes. "Not yet."Tang Yi's mouth twitched slightly, why did he feel like a bitch couple? Will you be responsible? Will you marry me? Why don't you go in..." Did you hear that?If he says he didn't lie, he means he didn't lie."Xiao Lan raised her head and looked at the whole audience with her beautiful eyes: "Today, this man has been guaranteed a bailout. Whoever refuses to accept it, just hold it in!"After saying that, she pulled Tang Yi and turned around to leave. Kong Shilan stood beside Xiao Lan and could only shake her head helplessly when she saw this scene. Do you want to obey me for everything you said? You have completely forgotten all your promises when you meet this bitch. However, the prince's guards were guarding the front and did not give way. Xiao Lan turned around, looked at the livid prince, and said: "Brother prince, I have guards as well."Do you really want to start a war with me?""As soon as he finished speaking, Tang Yi saw the street ahead. Hundreds of people in casual clothes quickly surrounded Tianxiang Tower. Xiao Lan didn't like people following her, and those who protected her were in secret. Especially after what happened last night, the emperor increased the number of his guards, not because he was afraid that he could not protect her, but because he was afraid that she would get lost again. At the scene, everyone's eyes fell on TangWhat did this guy do to the princess?To make the unruly and willful Princess Gaoyang so devoted to him.Tang Jing was so frightened that the princess and the prince fought each other, and the Tang family would be devastated.Kong Shilan was also frightened and glared at Tang Yi: "Think of a way to persuade this little devil, otherwise, things will go wrong."Tang Yi was also speechless. This was very inconsistent with his plan. Originally, his plan was to disrupt the Huang Tang family's celebration banquet. In the future, when Tang Hua's incident was exposed, the angry emperor would not involve him and Tang Yin. Besides, he was giving the Zhuge Godly Crossbow to the composite bow, and theThe emperor can't be so disrespectful when planning, but he really didn't expect that a Tang family celebration banquet would involve the prince and the princess.If there was a fight, the matter would get out of control."No, no, there is no need. This is a society governed by law. We must enforce the law."Tang Yi quickly grabbed Xiao Lan and said, "I have evidence. I have evidence that Tang Hao and Lin Zhu hurt my sister.""There was a jade pendant that Uncle Xiao gave to Tang Yin, but it was snatched away by Lin Zhu."Tang Yi looked at Tang Jing and said in a reminding tone: "Tang Shilang, that's the Uncle Xiao who gave me and Tang Yin money before.""Boom! Tang Jing had been scared out of his wits. Now when he heard Tang Yi's words, he felt dizzy and fell to the ground. The uncle Xiao who gave Tang Yi and Tang Yin money was the current emperor Xiao Ce! Oh my God. Three heavyweights from the royal family were given to a Tang family banquet.Involved.And Lin Zhu actually snatched His Majesty's jade pendant!Everyone was shocked when they saw Tang Jing kneeling on the ground.Who is Xiao?"Where is the jade pendant?"Little beast, where is the jade pendant?"At this time, Tang Jing suddenly got angry and rushed directly in front of Tang Hao. He raised his hand and said loudly! "Where is the jade pendant?Give me the jade pendant quickly."Tang Jing's voice was vibrating. Last time, Yan Shuangyu secretly used the money His Majesty gave Tang Yi. His Majesty chatted with him for half a stick of incense and almost brought him to the Palace of Hell. Now Tang Hao and Lin Zhu have snatched away the jade pendant that His Majesty gave Tang Yin. Can he still live to chat with His Majesty for half a stick of incense?Two things to say.In the past, His Majesty would have just been talking about it, but now that the armies of Beidi and Dongyu are approaching, he not only advocates moving the capital, but also celebrates his son's success as the Minister of Civil Affairs... Maybe His Majesty is not happy, and he is the chicken who was killed to scare the monkeys.Tang Hao was fooled on the spot., he and Lin Zhu beat Tang Yin half to death that day, and indeed snatched a jade pendant from Tang Yin's hand.But he didn't expect that his father, who had never believed Tang Yi, would beat him for a jade pendant.Lin Zhu's face turned pale, and he subconsciously wanted to kill him, regardless of the pain in his hand.The very beautiful jade pendant around her waist was hidden. But Yan Shuangyu was heartbroken when she saw her son being beaten.Unaware of the seriousness of the matter, she snatched the jade pendant from Lin Zhu's waist and quickly stopped in front of Tang Jing, "Master, why are you beating the child? What's wrong with the child."You believe everything Tang Yi says and don't even give Haoer a chance to defend himself?"" Yan Shuangyu blinked, and tears immediately filled her eyes. She wanted to use her tears to deceive Tang Jing again. "Master, don't listen to Xiao Yi's nonsense. Xiao Hao and Lin Zhu did not snatch Tang Yin's jade pendant."This jade pendant is a gift that I bought for Xiao Hao and Lin Zhu. The past two days were their first wedding anniversary..." As she said that, she spread her palms. The jade pendant in her palm appeared in front of Tang Jing and the prince.When Tang Jing was petrified, the prince felt like he was struck by lightning.Is that his father’s jade pendant?Are you kidding me?
